title: Fei-Away/Codex-Dream-Skin
why_good: A 'skin' for Codex — cosmetic customization, not a product; the name and scope suggest a theme, not a business.
value: No real monetization; cosmetic add-ons rarely become companies.
risk: Feature/skin, not a startup; trivially cloned and dependent on Codex.
